name: @dsh-ui/desktop
description: DeepSeek Harness desktop shell (Tauri 2). Spawns the harness web profile and hosts its UI in a native window.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('../mobile-h5/dist-server/index.js'))throw new Error('缺少 ../mobile-h5/dist-server，请先构建 @dsh-ui/mobile-h5');fs.copyFileSync('../mobile-h5/dist-server/index.js','src-tauri/resources/mobile-bridge.js');if(!fs.existsSync('../mobile-h5/dist'))throw new Error('缺少 ../mobile-h5/dist，请先构建 @dsh-ui/mobile-h5');fs.cpSync('../mobile-h5/dist','src-tauri/resources/dist',{recursive:true});for(const p of ['dsh-deep-ui','dsh-remote']){fs.cpSync('../../plugins/'+p,'src-tauri/resources/plugins/'+p,{recursive:true})}"
